instructions.title: How to get PayOS information
instructions.step1: 1. Login to PayOS Dashboard at https://payos.vn/
instructions.step2: 2. Go to "API Management" -> "Settings" section to get required information
instructions.step3: 3. Copy Client ID, API Key and Checksum Key from the dashboard
instructions.step4: 4. Paste this information into the form above and click "Save Configuration"
